title: Diederick Janse (Energized.org) on Incorruptible: 'I thoroughly enjoyed Eric's book'
summary: Diederick Janse of the cooperative Energized.org, who works on self-management, says he thoroughly enjoyed Incorruptible.
blockquote: I thoroughly enjoyed Eric's book Incorruptible, and I'm on fire about the intersection between steward ownership (mission-locked companies) and self-management (bossless companies).
